about: Icon layers for the apps' maps, no build needed. Each layer: id; screens (cb6map, profile, boards; empty = every map); with: the overlay or topic it rides with (parks, schools, childcare, libraries, nypd, fire, subway, bus, bike, citibike, zoning, landuse, historic, csd, bids; empty = always); icon: mi:<file in civic/mapicons>, img:<file in civic/img>, a logo file name, or sf:<SF Symbol>#<hex>; color (#RRGGBB); size (points); dense (true: hides behind others when crowded until zoomed in); points: [lat, lng, title, subtitle].
